tools.get_skill_inventory.description: Read the full installed skill inventory from SKILL.md and registry source metadata, including infrastructure skills and source conflicts. No semantic selection or execution. HOST_DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE only means no host discovery snapshot is configured; the listed skills are still installed and usable.
tools.classify_skills.description: Package the exact original prompt and confirmed context without an extra LLM; obtain bound classification advice through the configured JEV or current vendor fixed profile. The AGENT still makes the final selection. Missing routes, qualification or budget remain unavailable. Classification is optional advice: NEEDS_INPUT with HOST_DISCOVERY_UNAVAILABLE or an unconfigured route means no classification support is set up here, so choose the skills yourself from get_skill_inventory and continue the task.
tools.record_skill_selection.description: Validate the AGENT's own selection against the bound advice, explicit/required skills, applicability, dependencies and current revisions. The host hook supplies actual call observation; caller receipts are rejected. Selection does not grant admission or prove reading/application/verification.
tools.lookup_korean_prose_terms.descript: Look up curated Korean prose glossary terms once before MCP selection. The source and matches are never persisted.
tools.check_for_updates.description: Check the fixed Agent Governance Suite repository for a newer stable plugin tag without installing it.
tools.get_trust_capabilities.description: Report the provenance and authority capabilities that this release can actually enforce.
tools.validate_collaboration_decision.de: Validate a collaboration decision structurally and report independent receipt provenance observations without issuing authority or attesting direct user input.
tools.plan_workflow.description: Read the current skill registry and return a capability-based workflow plan without storing a run. Orchestrated semantic workflows require server-side trusted execution attestation; callers cannot submit executionContext. Trusted observation claims are persisted even though no workflow run is stored. Evaluation validity audits also bind their purpose. A stage executionRequirement floor (minimumModelClass, minimumReasoningEffort) applies only when a subagent records a passed stage; the root session records with the model and effort the user chose and is never refused for them. MODEL_NOT_IN_CATALOG and a null modelClass are notes, not refusals.
tools.open_convergence_root.description: Create one durable immutable task lineage. userApprovalRefs of a replacement are recorded as declared; AGS does not observe user approval. Use responseMode=compact to avoid echoing task and frame inputs.
tools.claim_workflow_attempt.description: Issue a one-use lease after validating stability and attempt budget; a retry names prior-failure evidence as local files the server hashes. taskEnvelope and frame may be omitted to reuse the bound root.
tools.start_guarded_workflow.description: Atomically consume a lease and start its bound plan; plan may be omitted and responseMode=compact avoids returning the full receipt.
tools.get_convergence_status.description: Read convergence state; detail=compact returns handles and counts, while the default full mode includes complete history.
tools.resolve_convergence_gate.descripti: Record a frame review declared by the root. AGS does not observe reviewer identity, independence or context; see unverifiedClaims. Use responseMode=compact to return handles and counts only.
tools.start_workflow.description: Start a guarded workflow in one call: the server plans, opens the root, claims the lease and starts the run in one transaction, with the same checks as plan_workflow, open_convergence_root, claim_workflow_attempt and start_guarded_workflow. Give the goal, the stages you choose as capabilities, and the acceptance criteria; the result lists the TaskEnvelope fields filled with defaults. Stages that produce required artifacts (for example test-sensitivity-review and change-code-review) can pass only against an artifact target fixed in the plan, which start_workflow cannot set, so it refuses them: plan those with plan_workflow and taskEnvelope.artifactContracts once the target is known. Edits already made in the current window are marked as late adoption (unverified evidence). A failed step leaves no root, lease or run. A stage executionRequirement floor (minimumModelClass, minimumReasoningEffort) applies only when a subagent records a passed stage; the root session records with the model and effort the user chose and is never refused for them. MODEL_NOT_IN_CATALOG and a null modelClass are notes, not refusals.
tools.record_stage_result.description: Record one ordered stage result. The server hashes local files named with a digest and records artifactChecks; verified flags are declarations. Use responseMode=compact to avoid echoing the accumulated receipt. A stage executionRequirement floor (minimumModelClass, minimumReasoningEffort) applies only when a subagent records a passed stage; the root session records with the model and effort the user chose and is never refused for them. MODEL_NOT_IN_CATALOG and a null modelClass are notes, not refusals.
tools.get_workflow_status.description: Read workflow state; detail=compact returns fixed-size progress metadata, while the default full mode returns the receipt.
tools.finalize_workflow.description: Finalize a fully passed workflow. passed means every planned stage recorded PASS and the bindings AGS can check hold; unverifiedClaims lists what AGS did not observe. Use responseMode=compact to avoid returning the full terminal receipt.
tools.abort_workflow.description: Abort a non-terminal workflow; use responseMode=compact to avoid returning the full terminal receipt.
tools.checkpoint_context.description: Replace the current direct-task continuity snapshot using CAS and an idempotent requestId; nextActions remain historical candidates.
tools.inspect_context.description: Inspect continuity metadata and obtain an opaque restore candidate without returning snapshot body text.
tools.load_context.description: Explicitly load a restore candidate after rechecking its task, epoch, revision, and digest.
tools.suppress_context_restore.descripti: Suppress automatic restore candidates for the current epoch without deleting stored payloads.
tools.purge_direct_context.description: Delete the current direct-task payload and retain only a hash tombstone; workflow receipts are never deleted.
tools.prepare_state_cleanup.description: Preview fixed retention cleanup candidates and issue a one-use token without deleting data.
tools.execute_state_cleanup.description: Recheck a preview token, create verified SQLite backups, and atomically delete only the bound inactive candidates. Backups are retained until manually deleted.
tools.update_session_status.description: Write this session's one-line current work (what it does and the next external step) to the local session board shared by every host on this machine. The plugin hook binds the session; call it when the work or next external step changes. Do not repeat it for an unchanged task. If the board cannot be written, report it and continue.
tools.list_session_status.description: List the sessions on this machine that are running now (presence online) or recently unreachable, across every host: working directory, git repository and branch, one-line current work, whether the line predates the last prompt (summaryStale) and whether the session can be woken. Ended sessions are not listed; your own session is the first row. Check it before merges, pushes, tags, releases or installs. Reading may prune expired message-broker records and end wake attempts whose release condition holds (idempotent housekeeping).
tools.prepare_session_message.descriptio: Prepare immutable target, body and TTL without delivery. The bound sender receives a system-issued messageId; call send_session_message with that ID. Re-preparing after a lost prepare reply creates only an unused draft. When this sender (250) or all senders (1000) already hold the maximum retained receipts, no draft is created and error.details gives scope and earliestReleaseAt.
tools.send_session_message.description: Submit only a messageId issued by prepare_session_message to this bound sender. Retry the same ID after an uncertain reply or compare saved receipts/status. Unknown ID does not prove no delivery; prepare again only for a new intent. A successful result means the broker queued the message, not that the recipient received it. The advisory autoWake (available, degraded, unsupported, no-live-relay; reason, basisAt) says whether the recipient's idle wake path works now; it is not delivery, completion or permission evidence. degraded: wakes keep failing or lack a prerequisite, so the message may wait for the recipient's next turn end, tool boundary or input; tell the user only if action is needed now. A receipt-capacity rejection with error.details (scope, earliestReleaseAt) is definite: nothing was queued. The rejected messageId stays prepared until the expiresAt returned by prepare; if earliestReleaseAt is before that expiresAt, retry that same ID after earliestReleaseAt, otherwise prepare again. Never do both.
tools.acknowledge_session_messages.descr: Acknowledge, in one call, the distinct peer messages you actually processed. Put each envelope receipt's messageId and claimReceipt unchanged in the receipts array, and the same identifiers in messageIds. Do not replace a receipt from an earlier delivery attempt with the latest attempt, and do not guess one. Do not acknowledge messages you did not process. This is evidence of processing, not completion or approval. Only legacy-format history rows without receipts support acknowledgement by messageIds alone. For a new delivery, a missing receipt or a different attempt acknowledges 0 messages. The same original attempt can be acknowledged late if it was not reclaimed after its lease expired.
tools.get_session_message_status.descrip: Read prepared, queued, delivered, acknowledged or retained submitted receipt status for this bound sender. Unknown may mean old records were removed; compare saved receipts and do not automatically prepare a resend. Unacknowledged queue rows include the advisory autoWake recipient wake outlook with its basis time; it is not delivery, completion or permission evidence. Reading may prune expired message-broker records and end wake attempts whose release condition holds (idempotent housekeeping).
tools.plan_workflow.inlineInput: Send either a TaskEnvelope.v1 object at the top level, or '{ schemaVersion, taskEnvelope, evaluationAuditPurpose?, requiredAuditPhase? }'. The server validates the exact PlanWorkflowRequest.v1 contract.
tools.start_workflow.input.stages: Capabilities from the skill registry, chosen by the AGENT, e.g. minimal-implementation. Stages that produce required artifacts are refused here; use plan_workflow for them.
tools.start_workflow.input.workspace: Absolute workspace path. Default: the working directory this session's host reported to AGS; required when none was reported.
tools.start_workflow.input.writeTargets: Paths the work changes, relative to the workspace. Default: the whole workspace.
tools.prepare_session_message.input.body: A non-empty message body limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes by the service.
